name: Soul Blue
source:
"Behave if you know what's good for you. You lascivious thing..."

Sakuru awoke that morning from a terrible dream.
At nightfall he was assigned a mission of protection through the maze.
Simple and petty work for a soldier like Sakuru, or so he thought.
His ward was a young man named Alde, a spellcaster. They should have had no trouble in the labyrinth, but
an unexpected accident sent them on an unexpected course...

A novel-like fantasy AVG.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE129521.html]English DLSite[/url]]
translation:
“识相的话就老实点。你这个好色的家伙……”

樱良在那天早晨从一场可怕的梦中醒来。
入夜后，他接到穿越迷宫执行护卫任务的命令。
对樱良这样的士兵来说，这不过是简单又琐碎的工作——他原本是这么想的。
他的保护对象是一名叫阿尔德的年轻法师。他们本不该在迷宫中遇到麻烦，可一场意外却让他们走上了意想不到的道路……

一部小说风格的幻想AVG。

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE129521.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
